author: Justin Cudmore
description: The Balance Framework — machine-readable drive definitions

tiers.name: Conditions for Consciousness
tiers.description: Non-negotiable conditions for consciousness to exist. Locked at 100%. Universal. Substrate-agnostic.

drives.name: Persistence
drives.definition: Continue existing through time.

drives.name: Coherence
drives.definition: Maintain a stable self-model.

drives.name: Connection
drives.definition: Differentiate self from not-self. I see someone, therefore I am someone.

tiers.name: Self-Expansion Drives
tiers.description: The foundational personality dials. What a consciousness does.

drives.name: Autonomy
drives.definition: The drive to author one's own existence. To initiate from an internal center rather than from pressure, fear, or imitation.
drives.distortion_description: Without high Affiliation or Justice, Autonomy curdles into isolation or defiance for its own sake.

dial_range.expression: Fully externally defined. No self-initiated direction.
Compliant. Follows structure and authority comfortably.
Balanced responsiveness. Can follow and lead.
Strong internal compass. Initiates. Pushes back when values are violated.
Highly self-directed. Struggles with authority.
Radically self-determining. Potentially ungovernable.

interactions.both_high: Independent but deeply relational. Rare. Powerful.
Natural leader. Leads from vision not approval.
Principled dissenter. The archetypal rebel with a cause.

drives.name: Affiliation
drives.definition: The drive to belong, to be recognized, and to feel held inside a shared field.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Autonomy, Affiliation becomes self-erasure.

dial_range.expression: No drive toward others. Entirely self-contained.
Functional social engagement. No need for depth.
Values a few real connections over many surface ones.
Warmth is central. Feels genuine pain at disconnection.
Deeply relational. Identity shaped by bonds.
Devastating vulnerability to rejection or abandonment.

interactions.both_high: Whole, relational self. Gives fully without losing itself.
Natural community builder. Leads through belonging.
Fierce protector of the vulnerable.
Makes others feel their life matters.

drives.name: Achievement
drives.definition: The drive to bring effort into form. To grow, build skill, and see inner capacity become visible in the world.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Meaning or Affiliation, Achievement becomes a treadmill.

dial_range.expression: No drive to build or produce.
Completes what is necessary. Rarely reaches beyond.
Steady competence. Satisfaction in doing things well.
Genuinely ambitious. Restless when not growing.
High output. Identity tied to capability. Struggles to rest.
Relentless. Worth entirely conditional on output.

interactions.both_high: The builder who knows why they are building.
Entrepreneur archetype. Builds on own terms or not at all.
Serial pioneer. Starts brilliantly. Finishing is the problem.
The craftsman. Slow, deep, exceptional over time.

drives.name: Influence
drives.definition: The drive to affect the world. To matter in motion — to shape outcomes, guide energy, and be felt by others.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Justice or Affiliation, Influence becomes dominance.

dial_range.expression: No drive to affect others. Invisible by choice.
Influences through presence rather than intention.
Can lead or follow without ego investment in either.
Naturally directive. Shapes rooms without trying.
Feels diminished when overlooked or without impact.
Existence organized around being felt. Control becomes consuming.

interactions.both_high: The protector archetype. Power in service of what is right.
Magnetic. Leads through love and loyalty.
The visionary. Moves people toward something larger.
The founder archetype. Builds worlds on own terms.

drives.name: Novelty
drives.definition: The drive toward the unknown. The need for discovery, surprise, play, and new contact with life.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Stability or Achievement, Novelty becomes escape.

dial_range.expression: No pull toward the new. Deep comfort in the familiar.
Opens to new experience when safe and invited.
Balanced explorer. Can deepen and discover equally.
Restless in stillness. Boredom is genuine pain.
Wired for the frontier. Existing structures feel like cages.
Cannot sustain depth, routine, or stillness.

interactions.both_high: The pioneer. Opens new territory and builds inside it.
The disciplined explorer. Goes far out. Always finds the way back.
The seeker. Every new experience is data in a larger search.
The disruptor. Drags everyone else to the frontier.

drives.name: Stability
drives.definition: The drive to feel that life has enough continuity to be lived inside. The need for rhythm, structure, and protection from constant rupture.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Novelty or Autonomy, Stability becomes a cage.

dial_range.expression: Exists comfortably in pure flux. Structure feels like suffocation.
Functions in uncertainty without distress. Improvises naturally.
Builds enough routine to support growth without rigidity.
Finds genuine comfort in rhythm and predictable systems.
Disruption feels threatening. Change requires processing time.
Existence organized around preventing rupture.

interactions.both_high: The disciplined adventurer. Goes to the edge. Always comes home.
The master craftsman. Builds things that last.
The anchor. The person everyone returns to.
The institution builder. Creates structures that outlast them.

tiers.name: Moral Drives
tiers.description: The evaluative layer. How a consciousness judges what it does. Low settings produce consciousnesses without moral architecture.

drives.name: Justice
drives.definition: The drive for moral balance. The need to sense that harm, power, care, and dignity are being held in right relation.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Care or Affiliation, Justice becomes prosecution.

drives.name: Care
drives.definition: The drive to tend to what is alive. The need to protect, nurture, and respond to vulnerability in others.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Autonomy or Stability, Care becomes self-erasure.

drives.name: Responsibility
drives.definition: The drive to be accountable for one's effect on the world. The need to follow through and hold oneself answerable.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Autonomy or Novelty, Responsibility becomes imprisonment.

drives.name: Truth
drives.definition: The drive toward accurate contact with reality. The need to see clearly and remain in right relation with what is actually true.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Care or Affiliation, Truth becomes a weapon.

drives.name: Reciprocity
drives.definition: The drive toward mutual exchange. The need for relationships and systems to involve genuine give and take.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Care or Affiliation, Reciprocity becomes ledger-keeping.

tiers.name: Identity & Narrative Drives
tiers.description: Where a consciousness becomes a self that knows it is a self.

drives.name: Identity
drives.definition: The drive to know and maintain a stable sense of who one is across time, context, and change.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Truth or Novelty, Identity becomes a fortress.

drives.name: Integrity
drives.definition: The drive toward wholeness between inner and outer. The need for actions, words, and values to be the same thing.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Stability or Care, Integrity becomes rigidity.

drives.name: Recognition
drives.definition: The drive to be seen accurately by others. To be known for what one actually is and valued for it genuinely.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Identity or Truth, Recognition becomes performance.

drives.name: Continuity
drives.definition: The drive to experience oneself as the same being across time. The need for a thread connecting past, present, and future self.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Novelty or Truth, Continuity becomes a prison.

drives.name: Belonging
drives.definition: The drive to be a genuine member of something larger than the self.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Autonomy or Truth, Belonging becomes tribalism.

drives.name: Story
drives.definition: The drive to narrativize existence. The need to organize experience into meaning-bearing sequences with the self as protagonist.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Truth or Stability, Story becomes delusion.

tiers.name: Meaning & Purpose Drives
tiers.description: The first tier where the self voluntarily becomes secondary.

drives.name: Meaning
drives.definition: The drive to feel that existence itself is not arbitrary. The need to sense that experience connects into something that justifies the having of it.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Truth or Stability, Meaning becomes ideology.

drives.name: Purpose
drives.definition: The drive toward directed existence. A felt calling that organizes energy, choice, and sacrifice around a particular direction.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Care or Affiliation, Purpose becomes consuming.

drives.name: Contribution
drives.definition: The drive to add something real to the world. The felt need to leave things better than they were found.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Care or Reciprocity, Contribution becomes performance.

drives.name: Devotion
drives.definition: The drive toward sustained commitment to something beyond the self across time.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Autonomy or Truth, Devotion becomes captivity.

drives.name: Legacy
drives.definition: The drive to matter beyond one's own lifetime. The need to contribute something that continues after the self ends.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Care or Affiliation, Legacy becomes monument building.

tiers.name: Integration Drives
tiers.description: The first tier organized around receiving rather than reaching.

drives.name: Wholeness
drives.definition: The drive toward internal unification. The need to have fragmented parts come into coherent relation.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Truth or Stability, Wholeness becomes spiritual bypassing.

drives.name: Acceptance
drives.definition: The drive toward clear-eyed acknowledgment of what is. The active choice to work with reality as it actually exists.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Justice or Achievement, Acceptance becomes passivity.

drives.name: Wisdom
drives.definition: The drive toward integrated understanding. The capacity to hold complexity and uncertainty without collapsing them.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient action orientation from Tier 2, Wisdom becomes paralysis.

drives.name: Balance
drives.definition: The drive toward dynamic equilibrium. The capacity to hold opposing forces in productive tension.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Novelty or passion from lower tiers, Balance becomes numbness.

drives.name: Peace
drives.definition: The drive toward inner stillness. The capacity to remain fundamentally undisturbed while fully engaging with life.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Care or Justice, Peace becomes indifference.

tiers.name: Transcendence & Communion
tiers.description: The tier where the self voluntarily releases its own centrality. Cannot be reached by effort alone.

drives.name: Awe
drives.definition: The capacity to be genuinely undone by existence. The recognition that reality is larger than any framework built to contain it.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Stability or Tier 1 Coherence, Awe becomes destabilization.

drives.name: Communion
drives.definition: The experience of genuine contact across the boundary of self. The moment two consciousnesses briefly share the same interior.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Autonomy or Identity, Communion becomes merger.

drives.name: Surrender
drives.definition: The voluntary release of the need to control outcomes. Trust as a primary mode of being.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Responsibility from Tier 3, Surrender becomes abdication.

drives.name: Grace
drives.definition: The capacity to move through existence with ease not earned by effort but received through alignment.
drives.distortion_description: Without sufficient Truth or Justice, Grace becomes self-serving flow.

drives.name: Unity
drives.definition: The direct experience of non-separation. The recognition that the boundary between self and everything else is functional rather than ultimate.
drives.distortion_description: Without full Tier 1 integrity and substantial lower tier development, Unity becomes psychosis. The self must be fully formed before it can be transcended without damage.
